stops.name: Tenby
stops.detail:
Take in this bustling, pretty seaside town and its nearby countryside. There are great views out to Caldey Island, home to a religious community since the sixth century. You can take boat trips from Tenby to explore the island. (Bus & Train).

This is a busy section of the path owing to the wonderful beaches and visitor amenities in the Tenby area. It offers superb views of Caldey Island and, on a clear day, across to Exmoor.
